catalogue.note: The button dock and Android bottom bar that sit under the third 2.0 card, detached from it in Figma (129 below, with a zigzag between them), so it is a piece of its own. Drawn at 0.75: built at 362.67×130.67 with every value divided by 0.75: 40-high button, 24 radius, 16 top corners on the dock (they are the dock’s own, kept). The button label is 11px in Figma here (14.67 real) against 10.5 (14) in the full-dress screens. Back, home and recents are Figma’s export of the group. Figma snaps each text baseline to a whole pixel at its own small scale, so some lines sit up to 1px lower in Figma than in a browser; they are left where the browser puts them. Edges that fall on fractions of a pixel are blurred over two rows by Figma and snapped to one by Chrome. Flat fills match exactly.
